summary: win_iis_website moves to microsoft.iis.website, and win_inet_proxy, win_listen_ports_facts, win_mapped_drive, win_product_facts, win_region, win_route, win_timezone and win_user_profile redirect to ansible.windows.

answer_card.title: community.windows modules moving to ansible.windows (part 2)
answer_card.answer_md:
- `win_iis_website` → `microsoft.iis.website` (removed in 4.0.0).
- Redirected to `ansible.windows.<same name>`, redirect removed in 4.0.0: `win_inet_proxy`, `win_listen_ports_facts`, `win_mapped_drive`, `win_product_facts`, `win_region`, `win_route`, `win_timezone`, `win_user_profile`.
